comparison.objective: Purge air from a filled syringe while preserving the liquid sample.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient the syringe to move the bubble, stabilize the barrel, and advance the plunger with fine volume control.
comparison.success_condition: Residual air and sample loss meet thresholds, no excessive aspiration/loss occurs, syringe returns to its rack, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Bimanual fluid-management and plunger metering are materially different from rigid tool/collar manipulation and carriage-stop commissioning.
